title: SDV Synthetic Data Generation Examples
summary: A Korean-language tutorial repository of example scripts demonstrating how to generate synthetic tabular and relational data, including multi-table foreign-key preservation, metadata management, Korean categorical data handling, and quality evaluation. It directly runs SDV's HMASynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and evaluate_quality functions to build and assess synthetic datasets.
